title: Payment Arrangement Tenure Months on Renegotiated Schedules
content:
# Payment Arrangement Tenure Months on Renegotiated Schedules

**Schedule.** When the installment schedule of an active Payment Arrangement plan is renegotiated, the tenure months are set by the start date of the Electric Service Agreement carrying the plan:

| Start date of the Electric Service Agreement | Tenure months |
|---|---|
| At least 180 whole calendar months before the renegotiation | 2 |
| At least 120 but fewer than 180 whole calendar months before the renegotiation | 1 |
| Fewer than 120 whole calendar months before the renegotiation | 0 |

¹ Months between the start date and the renegotiation are counted in whole calendar months.

## Boundary footnotes (hypothetical agreement started April 12, 2011)

| Renegotiation dated | Whole calendar months since the start date | Tenure months |
|---|---|---|
| April 11, 2021 | 119 | 0 |
| April 12, 2021 | 120 | 1 |
| April 11, 2026 | 179 | 1 |
| April 12, 2026 | 180 | 2 |
